description: This file defines the AssetResolverInterface interface in Drupal, which specifies methods for resolving asset libraries into concrete CSS and JavaScript assets, including handling asset ordering, optimization, and language considerations.

classes.name: AssetResolverInterface
classes.description: Interface for resolving asset libraries into concrete CSS and JavaScript assets in Drupal.

methods.name: getCssAssets
methods.description: Returns the CSS assets for the current response's libraries, ordered and optionally optimized, considering language.

methods.name: getJsAssets
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript assets for the current response's libraries, ordered and optionally optimized, considering language.
